description: This header file defines utility functions and a class for file operations within the ocudulog namespace, including error formatting, filename splitting, filename building, and a file handling class with create, write, flush, and close methods.

classes.name: file
classes.description: Provides basic file operations such as create, write, flush, and close, managing a file handle and path.

methods.name: format_error
methods.description: Formats system error messages with an error string and code.

methods.name: split_filename_extension
methods.description: Splits a filename into name and extension, handling edge cases.

methods.name: build_filename_with_index
methods.description: Constructs a filename with an index appended before the extension.
